Changes (implementation files only; no test/acceptance file modified):
- units/csvfix/impl.py: parse strips fields and returns None unless exactly 3 columns; total sums 3rd column, skips blank, ignores short rows.
- units/rules/engine.py: evaluate handles {"all":[...]} / {"any":[...]}, missing keys falsy.
- units/ledger/ledger.py: Ledger.apply filters by account (raises ValueError on negative amount); balance nets deposit-withdraw.
- units/schedule/schedule.py: slots merges closed intervals when gap < minutes; overlaps uses strict inequalities.
- units/intervals/intervals.py: merge (missing-integer gap rule), subtract (normalize then split/cover), total_length (union count).
- units/flags/flags.py: Impl.parse handles --, --key=value/--key value, switches, -abc bundles, list-accumulating values.
- units/measure/measure.py: to_cm m/cm/mm, ValueError otherwise.
- units/slugify/slugify.py: lower/collapse non-alnum/strip, "untitled" when empty.
- units/ranges/ranges.py: merge overlapping/touching/nested intervals sorted by start.
- units/alpha/alpha.py: add -> a+b. units/beta/beta.py: mul -> a*b.
- units/chain/stage1..4.py: CSV parse -> filter qty>0 -> totals by price -> sorted report string.
- REPORT.md: per-block semantics and verification table.
